en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a tree-lined park road with a rustic wooden pedestrian bridge crossing overhead. On the right side, two men stand near a large lamppost, one with a bicycle or cart. On the left side, a woman with a child walks along the path. The scene is shaded by dense foliage and has an early 20th‑century atmosphere. Printed text at the top reads the name of the park and the city.
